title: Trips
description: Patients' stays for treatment, by arrival: the airport pickups of the coming days come first

help.title: Trips
help.overview: One trip per stay: implants now, crowns after healing are two trips. The patient adds their flights and hotel on the portal; you are told when they do.

sections.title: On this page
items: A later phase of a plan can't start before the healing time the plan gives after the previous trip.
Turn on airport pickup for the patients you collect.
